steps.content: Even the sun can't shine through the rising smoke, and the rumbling of the tracks and the huge, muddy figure in the smoke has taken the breath away from everyone present.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...That's an FAC armor used to deal with Corruptors, and it's very lethal. What are they...

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Enough about the FAC. The Reconstruction Executive Committee specifically asked the City Council's Speaker to deploy this big thing.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: FAC-Propulsion Type 023, just decommissioned from DisSea Surveillance Zone, is exceptionally well maintained. Composite function, fully automatic attack, automatic repair, full ammunition reserve, and heavy firepower.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Think about it. Do you have skin as thick as the Corruptors?

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Or do you think your pathetic little bullets can penetrate the armor of this beast?

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: ...You bastard. There are still so many people in the camp, and you're going to use that?

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Didn't you ask for this, our righteous little hero?

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: I was just going to scare you off, but thanks to you, this is a big deal now, and the executive committee is really on the lookout for it.
He laughs and suddenly turns up the sound of the speaker to the maximum...

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: But there's still a chance for everyone...

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: If you don't want to be dragged down by these fools, run! Run far away, hand over Drifter Camp, and you'll be fine!

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: Don't look down on us! Rustfire will not give in, we can fight, we have our own power!

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Power...? Do you mean this kind of power?
The barrel stretches out, rotates, and suddenly fires a high-speed energy projectile, hitting a corner of Drifter Camp and triggering a burst of alarm.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Phew... Incredible. But don't be afraid. It's just an abandoned warehouse, stocked with expired rations sent from Eastside. I know very well that there's no one there.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: But it's hard to say what I will target... in half an hour.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: All we want is this place to investigate the Mania, and nothing will happen if you leave in half an hour!

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Run! Run now! There's only half an hour left!

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: ...You bastard!
You are suddenly grabbed over, and Taran points a gun at your temple.

steps.speaker: Hecate & Hella
steps.content:
Chief!
You little piece of...!!!

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: Stop! This is the expert you're looking for, the chief of Minos Bureau of Crisis Control, the hero that helped you take down the Legion.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Oh, a Sinner girl. Could it really... be him?
steps.female_content: Oh, a Sinner girl. Could it really... be her?

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: Pull back now if you don't want to see his head blown off!
steps.female_content: Pull back now if you don't want to see her head blown off!

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: Don't you want him to take care of Black Rings? You can't take responsibility for his death, can you, traitor?
steps.female_content: Don't you want her to take care of Black Rings? You can't take responsibility for her death, can you, traitor?

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Well... It will be difficult to explain. But... wasn't he killed by the gangsters, Taran? You testified.
steps.female_content: Well... It will be difficult to explain. But... wasn't she killed by the gangsters, Taran? You testified.

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: You...

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Even if he is important to the FAC, what does that have to do with me? I'm just a traitor who came to complete the mission given by my superiors. My superiors gave me the task of cleaning up Drifter Camp.
steps.female_content: Even if she is important to the FAC, what does that have to do with me? I'm just a traitor who came to complete the mission given by my superiors. My superiors gave me the task of cleaning up Drifter Camp.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: You're a little too naive, Taran. Didn't that man teach you anything?

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Did he also teach you... to live and die for your pathetic ideals?

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: Shut it!!! You're not in a place to say anything about him!!!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Calm down, kid. You've messed this up well enough.

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: What did you say?

steps.speaker: Choice
options: You can't defeat him. Let me do this.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Now I see it. It's you who want me dead, not your superiors.

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: What are you talking about? Why would I...

steps.speaker: Communication
steps.content: Buzz...
You notice that Taran's comm is on. You can't hear the other side clearly, but you know they can hear you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Want to see where I stand? Let go of me. I'll show you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: There is no other way!

steps.speaker: Communication
steps.content: Buzz...

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: But!

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: ...Understood.
He shoves you forward, and with a twist of his blade, he cuts off the rope.
You rub your strangled arms and walk over to the Sinners, facing the huge armed robot.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Yo! I don't know you, but I bet you are a big shot. Shall I take you home?

steps.speaker: Choice
options: The contamination here has nothing to do with the Drifter Camp.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Stop your so-called mission. I know what the Reconstruction Executive Committee is planning.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Hmm… You're making it very difficult for me... Should I call someone and make you go back?

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: But my superior would say...

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Complete your mission first.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Then you can say goodbye to your robot!
